entities.name: Sofia Antoniadis
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sophia Antoniadis was a Greek Byzantinist. She was the first female professor at the Leiden University, the first female Humanities professor in the Netherlands and during her career was one of the few Greek women to hold a position at a European university.
